fieldValues.title: Id canonicalisation is written once in the clerk
fieldValues.decision_question: Where does the id-canonicalisation function used by the grounding check live?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The id-canonicalisation function is written once in the clerk and reused by every programme check; a copy of the srs-web function is a stated exception to Core service over adapter logic until it moves into core.
fieldValues.rationale: Cites the principle Core service over adapter logic: shared logic belongs at the lowest shared layer. A JavaScript copy is an exception to it under the decision No core changes until the process is refined, and is named here so it is not forgotten.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the process has settled and the copy is ready to move into core, or when the two copies disagree on an id.
